sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dizzy, feels intoxicated. Pressure out-
wards; worse, occiput. Pain in ears. Coryza. Burning
in throat. Foul mouth in morning. Coryza with dizzi-
ness and sneezing.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Wheezing; asthma, with coryza and
mucous secretions. Dull pain in right lung. Burning
in fauces.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Sore, dragging in testicle, could not bear
any pressure; better gentle support.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Grind.; Aral.; Eucalyp.;
I pec.
